name: One Lover Vol 2 -Shirley Hen-
original_name: わんらば vol2　―シャーリー 編―
source: Gale has sex with his little lover Shirley in several different ways each involving a different magic spell or medicine, such as turning Shirley into a mermaid, a slave to passion, or into a virgin again.
